verdicts.reason: Both pull the building photo in from the left edge, which leaves an unexplained white strip of about 175px on the left. In the original the photo bleeds off the left edge, so this breaks it, and both also leave a wide empty right margin where the headline used to sit tight to the edge. A keeps the headline larger and more dominant, so it reads as the focal point. In B the headline is smaller and sits further left, which leaves more dead space on both sides and weakens the hierarchy.
